quests.title: Express Through Mounty County
quests.blurb: A crew are filming a hardship program out the window of the 11:42, doing ninety, windows up. I want one of them standing on my platform with a coffee going cold in their hand.

steps.label: let Rhonda talk you through it, the whole timetable included
photograph Mount Druitt the way the express never will: standing in it
ride west first, the direction nobody has ever pointed a lens
two flat whites at Penrith, one of them not for you
come back in all stations, at the speed everybody else sees it
cover both fares yourself; nobody out here is expensing you
find out who was actually holding the clipboard

quests.title: Change of Use, With Seating
quests.blurb: The Bourke Road roastery has put four stools on the footpath. That is a change of use. Notification, heritage statement, advertising fee, hard copy to Town Hall. The applicant is in Newcastle. You look free.

steps.label: attend the subject site on Bourke Road and pace out the footpath. It is 2.1 metres. It was 2.1 metres before the stools.
purchase two (2) beverages from the premises. One is the sensory baseline. One is Nerida's.
photograph the Sydney Park brick kilns for the Statement of Heritage Impact. They are 900 metres away. The template has a field.
complete neighbour notification with the four objectors within forty metres. In person. Council prefers a paper trail.
raise the Notification and Advertising Fee. Non-refundable. Payable whether or not anything is ever built or sat on.
lodge the hard copy at Town Hall House. The portal accepted it on Tuesday. The portal is not the record.

quests.title: The Fourth Trench on Church Street
quests.blurb: Poured that footpath twice. Water cut it, then gas cut it, then the light rail cut it. Now there's a fourth mob out there with a saw and a work order, and I want it on record that it was flat when I left.

steps.label: stand on the slab at the top of Church Street
move four signwriters off a green pour
two flat whites: one of them is not for you
one stop to Harris Park; you cannot walk it
photograph the trench they have already opened
invoice somebody for pour number three
show Macca the photo

quests.title: Unit 604 Shows Beautifully
quests.blurb: Unit 604, eleven o'clock, and so far the crowd is me. I need bodies on the landing and a photo the netting stays out of. There is a report on the building. There is a report on every building.

steps.label: be at the eleven o'clock, and be two people if you can
the hero shot from the park, netting out of frame
the neighbours who mention the report to every buyer
arrive the way a buyer would: one stop, plus the gate fee
a holding deposit, in cash, so the vendor feels something
tell Cheryl which one was actually going to bid

quests.title: The Green Is Not Underutilised
quests.blurb: Forty-two townhouses and a communal recreation space. That's a lawn with a barbecue on it. The DA says my green is underutilised. I want that disproved, photographed, and lodged at Gordon before four.

steps.label: photograph the green in play — feet on the mat, jack down, sun on it
take a session of pennant training, so the record says somebody trained here this year
sell $70 of chook raffle tickets at the bar — the objection has a printing cost
catch the train down to Chatswood, where the district side plays
get to Chatswood Oval before they finish pegging out the outfield
discuss the survey pegs with the four blokes holding them
lodge the objection at the Ku-ring-gai chambers at Gordon — the counter shuts at four
back up the hill to the bowlo, and tell Coral what they said

quests.title: Nobody Has Ever Been Booked in Rookwood
quests.blurb: A million residents in there and not one's ever blown into a tube. That's either the law or it's manners, and the kitty says manners. Make yourself known on Railway Street, then walk in the gate and count how far it follows you.

steps.label: coffee off Railway Street first. Gaz does not time a man who hasn't had one
give three people outside the shopping centre something worth ringing in
the breath testing unit parked outside the club on Joseph Street: introduce yourself
handle the two that get there first, while the rest are still on Parramatta Road
one photo at the Necropolis gate, timestamped, so the crematorium bloke can't argue the toss
out at Berala, one stop back on the all-stops. The dead had their own train in here; you don't
tell Gaz how far in it followed you

quests.title: The Monday Inventory
quests.blurb: Eleven pools on Wolseley Road and I've kept a book since March. Monday the leaf nets are hung properly, the teak's unscratched, and the coin I dropped in the skimmer is back in my pocket. Warm.

steps.label: come in the way the staff come in: Central to Edgecliff, before the road fills up
buy a coffee up here once, so you understand what these people are paying for water
top of the hill, where the whole Point Piper waterfront is in one frame — photograph it Sunday-side
three neighbours will ask what you're doing on their footpath. They ask with the phone already out
get seventy dollars out of the eastern suburbs. Not by invoice. Nobody up here has ever paid an invoice
go back to the van and read the book with him

quests.title: One Stop Is Far Enough
quests.blurb: I can't go to Cabramatta. My aunty's committee sits outside the bakery from seven, and if they see me I'm engaged by Sunday. You go. Take photos. Say nothing to anyone with a clipboard.

steps.label: get a coffee in your hand — nobody photographs a bakery on a break
one stop. She has done the sums and it is still too close.
photograph the new shop's sign under the arch — the family name, spelt her family's way
the boys outside the phone repair place will try you for the coffee
photograph the queue at the original at the same hour, for the comparison
she said she'd cover the fare. Cover the fare.
get back up the line and show her

quests.title: Load-In: Newtown to the Kilns
quests.blurb: There's no party. There's a picnic. The picnic has four kilowatts of rig locked in a shed on Erskineville Road, the ute's got no rego, and the sun comes up at six whether we're ready or not.

steps.label: get the padlock code off Kez, who has never once said it out loud
the lockup off Erskineville Road — second roller door, the mural nobody finished
sixty dollars of diesel money, however the night hands it to you
two flat whites: the last two poured on King Street before the sun does anything
no rego on the ute, so the subwoofer catches the train like everybody else
two people who moved in beside a live music venue and then rang about the noise
photograph the rig at the Sydney Park brick kilns so next month's crew knows where the power is

quests.title: The Floating Forest, Wrong Side of the Fence
quests.blurb: Council fenced the only angle where dawn comes through the mangroves. I'm seventy-eight and my knees are a matter of public record. Get over, get the shot, get gone. There's a print in it. The fine is not my problem.

steps.label: one flat white; he does not brief anyone before caffeine
the end of the boardwalk, where the fence starts
the rusted hull with the trees growing out of it
outlast the three that come for the tripod
the booze bus on Concord Road would like a word
one stop over the river, be another river's problem
sixty for the infringement he said he would cover
back to tower 6 once they have stopped caring
